starting_pitcher.description: SP recent ERA / K-BB / IP — largest single-game lever

platoon_matchup.description: Lineup vs RHP/LHP splits vs starter handedness

offense_form.description: Rolling team runs / OPS-ish proxy last 10–15 games

bullpen.description: Bullpen ERA / leverage usage last 7–14 days

weather.description: Temp + wind out/in — mostly totals, some run impact

rest_travel.description: Off-days / travel (unused until rest feed is wired)

similar_pitcher_history.description: Offense vs similar SP profiles, weighted by lineup continuity

notes: MLB weights prioritize starting pitcher + platoon; park/weather mainly move totals. Live offense = form+Elo (no season-stat leakage).

confidence.notes: Prefer picks when SP ERA gap >=1 and |pred_margin|>=0.5 (~64% walk-forward)
